notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Some changes are coming to [b]Sagittarius: The Lost and Cursed[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3]\[GAMEPLAY][/h3][list][*][p]\[CHANGED] In Act II, added new possible teleport location in the basement[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] In Act II, lamps are now properly locked after completing one of The Visions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Good luck![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Based on your feedback, I've decided to make some changes to the Act II.[/p][p]From now on, Act II should feel more balanced and fair to play! Thanks for sharing your thoughts and helping me to improve the game!
[/p][p]Here are the changes:[/p][p][/p][h3]\[GAMEPLAY][/h3][list][*][p]\[CHANGED] In Act II, going back to the basement now teleports the player to the location farthest from the enemy[/p][/*][/list][h3]\[MAPS][/h3][list][*][p]\[FIXED] In Act II, updated map geometry[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Good luck![/p]
